header.function_name: XD08 Order Control Information to NSP Batch (ASN)

objective: To keep TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE in NSP up to date with the crossdock customer order lines of G-TOPAS (replicated in DB Surrounding): rows with ORDER_STATUS = '7' are inserted (new key) or updated (existing key); rows that changed to '6' (received) are updated.
Only the rows changed since the last successful run are taken (INTF_UPDATE_DT > watermark). Nothing is deleted, so the NSP columns HOLD_FLAG / PO_MAPPED_FLAG / CANCEL_STATUS keep their values.
Rows with status '2' (cancel) are taken by XD12 and processed by XD11 before this batch runs.

nodes.label: Rows changed since watermark: status 7 (all) and 6 (known keys)

extra_tables.title: Parameters
rows: Last INTF_UPDATE_DT taken by the previous successful run of this batch (kept in the Log); first run: all rows

extra_tables.title: Execution Schedule
rows: Scheduler, daily after G-TOPAS has provided the data (27:30); auto retry 3 times.

nodes.label: Rows changed since watermark: status 7 (all) and 6 (known keys)
Insert new keys / update existing keys

steps: The scheduler starts the batch after XD11 (job chain XD12 -> XD11 -> XD08). Write LOG1.

steps.text: Read the rows of TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (DB Surrounding) with INTF_UPDATE_DT > watermark:
children: ORDER_STATUS = '7': all rows (new crossdock lines, changed qty, split serials).
ORDER_STATUS = '6': only rows whose unique key already exists in TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (NSP) (received / allocated; no further action in NSP).
Other statuses are not taken; status '2' is taken by XD12.

steps.text: Upsert into TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (NSP) per unique key (incl. SERIAL_NO):
children: New key: insert all source columns; HOLD_FLAG = 'N', PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'N', CANCEL_STATUS = '-'.
Existing key: update all source columns; HOLD_FLAG, PO_MAPPED_FLAG and CANCEL_STATUS are not changed.

steps: No error: commit, save the new watermark (max INTF_UPDATE_DT taken) in the Log, LOG2. Error: roll back, watermark not changed, LOG3. Exit.

items: The source table is insert / update: a crossdock line starts with status 7 and can change to 6 (received / allocated) or 2 (reject / cancel). A partial cancel or receipt splits the line into a new SERIAL_NO (scenario file skenario_h0253.xlsx).
Scenario 1 (normal): 14-Oct status 7, qty 8 -> 15-Oct the same row status 6, qty 8: XD08 updates the row; the line is no longer taken by XD09 (status 7 only).
Only changed rows are read (INTF_UPDATE_DT > watermark); insert and update run in one transaction; the watermark is saved only when the run succeeds.
Rows with status 6 / 2 stay in the table for tracking (retention optional, TBC).
Read by XD09 (status 7 rows not mapped, not on hold), XD10 and XD11. Table structure: see Appendix.

logging_messages.message: H0253 status 7 / 6 sync ended. Status <STATUS>, inserted <INS>, updated <UPD>.

action.system: Write the log; save the new watermark when SUCCESS.

logging_messages.cause: Read from DB Surrounding or insert / update in NSP fails

action.system: Roll back; watermark not changed (rows taken again next run). STATUS = FAILED.

tables.name: TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE
tables.description: Order control data, pre-order picking info (I/F H02-53, DVJO950) replicated from DB Surrounding by XD08 / XD12. Structure from the G-TOPAS I/F layout; physical names follow the existing table. Key (PK) = unique key of the I/F layout. NSP keeps the rows with status 7, 6 and 2 (insert / update); rows with status 6 / 2 are kept for tracking only (retention optional, TBC). CANCEL_STATUS is a new NSP column (proposed).
columns: No.7 Serial No., Card No. Part of the key; distinguishes split records of the same order line. Added to the source table by the DB Surrounding team (decided 19-Oct).
No.8 TOPAS Order Type: '1': VOR, '2': E/O, '3': S/O, 'F': F/O
No.12 Original Shipping Qty or Estimated Shipping Qty
No.14 Order Status: '1': Pending '2': Reject/Cancel '3': B/O '4': Firm Order '5': Vender Direct '6': Allocation '7': Cross Dock
No.15 B/O Instruction Code: '1': B/O Cancel, '9': Follow-up
No.18 Direct Delivery Code: Blank: Not vendor direct delivery '1': Vendor direct delivery
No.19 Direct Delivery Flag: '0': Not direct delivery, '1': Direct delivery
No.25 Special Price Code: '1': Special price, Blank: Not applicable
No.29 B/O History Code: '0': Default, '1': B/O
No.33 Order Portion Code: '1': Reject '2': Alteration '3': Process '4': Amendment
No.35 Shipping Process Control Code: Blank: No change '1': Higher priority to B/O
No.36 Procurement Process Control Code: '1': Skip substitution check '2': Skip large order division (including skipping irregular order check) '3': '2' + skip order taking check '4
No.38 Created Demand Flag: '0': Not created demand, '1': Created demand
No.39 Special Customer Flag: '0': Regular, '1': Special
No.40 POSS Transmission Judgment Flag: '0': Out of target, '1': Transmission target
NSP column: hold by the D/S team in ASN Cross Dock Creation (XD10) ('Y' / 'N'); 'N' on insert, never changed by XD08 / XD12
NSP column: line mapped to a PO by [Create ASN] ('Y' / 'N'); 'N' on insert, never changed by XD08 / XD12
NSP column: '-' no cancel / 'P' cancel to be processed by XD11 (set by XD12) / 'D' processed by XD11
